issues.fix: src/11_exterior.js l.448-458. (1) l.448: nose = Math.sqrt(smooth(1.65, 3.0, x)) so width and height grow together over 1.35 m (an ellipsoid nose). (2) l.451: drop the 0.40 floor and use ridge = nacTop(x) + 0.55 * nose * (1 - 0.30 * smooth(3.6, 4.2, x) * (1 - smooth(4.4, 5.4, x))) + 0.70 * Math.pow(smooth(4.2, leE - E.x0, x), 0.55) * 0.35. That gives a peak near x 3.0-3.4, a saddle at 4.2-4.4 and the rise into the LE. (3) l.450: always sink the base the full 0.30 m (bot = nacTop(x) - 0.30 for x < 6.35) so the flanks enter the cowl at a shallow angle and no underside shows. (4) l.458: for k < 4 use r = Math.min(w * 0.36, d * 0.34) as for the rest, so the nose is not turned into a round tube. Check in w13A, s13A and c_nacelle_left that the top line falls monotonically forward of the peak.
